activeVersion.name: Use Add Tags endpoint for automation_replied
activeVersion.description: Reverts the additional_tags body param from the reply PUTs (only valid on Update Many Tickets, silently ignored on single-ticket Update) and instead adds a dedicated node calling PUT /api/v2/tickets/{id}/tags.json with a bare {"tags":["automation_replied"]} body - Zendesk's Add Tags endpoint, which appends without replacing.
